params.body:
## Why

`resources/views/export/index.blade.php` decides whether to draw the delete button with
`@if($deleteLink == true or $superuser == true)`. Those two variables come from
`App\Http\Middleware\Access`, which shared them only inside
`if (array_key_exists(1, $route) and $request->session()->has('MT_ACCESS'))`.

`MT_ACCESS` is written in exactly one place, `LoginController@authenticated`. A session that
is authenticated without passing through that method (a remember-me cookie, a session that
lost its data) reaches the page with `auth` satisfied and no rights in the session, so the
middleware shares nothing and the view reads variables that do not exist.

Pre-existing; not caused by the bidding-screen migration.

## When it throws

All three at once:

1. the session is authenticated but carries no `MT_ACCESS` (so the middleware also skips its
   own authorisation check and lets the request through);
2. the page renders the row loop, i.e. the dealer has at least one export vehicle. An empty
   list never reaches the `@if`, which is why this stayed hidden;
3. the view is one of the ~15 that read `$deleteLink` / `$addLink` / `$editLink` /
   `$superuser` unguarded (`export/index`, `offertes/indexRentals`, `simple/index`, the
   settings lists).

Result: `Undefined variable $deleteLink (View: resources/views/export/index.blade.php)`.

## What

One change, at the source: the four `View::share()` calls move out of the session guard and
run on every request the middleware handles. The values are unchanged — they still come from
`MT_ACCESS` when it is there, and stay `false` when it is not, which is the same page a fully
denied user already got. No `?? null` in any view; every view that reads them is fixed at
once, not just `/exports`.

Behaviour that did not change: who may delete, who is a superuser, and every redirect the
middleware performs. `$superuser` was and remains always `false` in this middleware.

## Checked

- `tests/Feature/ExportListAccessTest.php` (new): the exports list with a row renders for a
  session without rights (fails before this change with the undefined variable, passes after),
  plus one test that the delete affordance is present for a user who may delete and absent for
  one who may not, so the fix cannot silently grant rights.
- `php artisan test --filter='Export|Bidding|SmokeTest|Access|ClassReferencesResolve'`:
  138 tests green.
- `php artisan view:cache` and `php -l` over every compiled view.

Also scanned the other classic list partials for the same shape (a view reading a variable
only some routes share). Nothing else found: the only cross-route shared variables are these
four, and `resources/views/settings/setting/_tabs/transport.blade.php` already defends itself
locally with `LinkHelper::rights(...) || ($superuser ?? false)` — left as is, it is now
redundant rather than wrong.
params.title: Bidding list: no undefined variable when rows are present
